lines.speaker: N
lines.text: At two fourteen in the morning, Milo's phone screen lit up.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The text was from his mom on her hospital night shift.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: It read: Do not open the door for me tonight.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A second message flashed immediately after.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I am still at work. Whatever is downstairs is not me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Downstairs, heavy metal keys jingled in the front lock.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then, his mother's exact voice called out his name from the hallway.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A final text popped up on his screen.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The note said: Don't answer. It learns your voice.
